name: Indiabulls Limited

timeline.x: [Monitoring Agency Report] In terms of Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, please find attached report of Monitoring Agency (Acuite Ratings and Research Limited) confirming no deviation in the utilization of proceeds of funds raised by Indiabulls Limited (formerly Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited) (the  Company ), through preferential issue of convertible warrants, during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.The above-mentioned Report, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, which is self-explanatory and was placed before the Audit Committee of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e. November 5

[Allotment of Securities] Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 51,55,00,000 convertible Warrants to certain Promoter Group Entities and Non-Promoter Group Entities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on September 24, 2026.

[Acquisition] Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition of 70% of the issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital of the Fintech Cloud Private Limited and execution of definitive agreement, in this regard.
[Updates] Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification to Stock Exchanges on In-principle Application for Preferential Issue of the Company'.
[Preferential issue] Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue

[Outcome of Board Meeting] Indiabulls Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investment of INR 1000.07 Crore in the Company through issuance of convertible warrants  Disclosure in terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
